title: Design System: Ilhaam Ghiffari — Platform Engineering Portfolio

display.purpose: Hero name, section titles, contact mailto — the human voice. Instrument Serif only.

body.purpose: All running text and blog prose. JetBrains Mono, tracking 0.

label.purpose: Kickers, nav, meta, indexes, footer. Uppercase, 0.25em tracking — the prompt text.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and reveals.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Section link in the header — mono label, uppercase, tracked.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 0; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: EN/ID locale switch; active fills with lime + ink.
components.css: .ds-lang { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; background: none; border: 0; color: var(--ink-dim); cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 2px; } .ds-lang .ds-lang-on { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); padding: 2px 6px; } .ds-lang:hover { color: var(--accent); }

components.name: CTA Link
components.description: Inline call-to-action with a translating arrow.
components.css: .ds-cta { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-cta:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-cta-arw { display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta-arw { transform: translateY(3px); }

components.name: Work Row
components.description: Indexed project row with hairline separator; indents on hover.
components.html: 01Aceh Resilience Monitor2026→
components.css: .ds-work-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr auto 44px; gap: 28px; align-items: center; padding: 32px 14px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(238,236,228,0.12); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-idx { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(30px, 4.2vw, 56px); line-height: 1.02; } .ds-meta { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: var(--muted); } .ds-work-row:hover { transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-title { color: var(--accent); } .ds-arw { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.4s; } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-arw { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Blog Row
components.description: Post row with title, date, arrow; indents on hover.
components.html: Setup CI/CD GitHub Actions2026→
components.css: .ds-blog-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; gap: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 34px 12px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(238,236,228,0.12); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-blog-row .ds-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 44px); line-height: 1.05; } .ds-blog-row .ds-date { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); } .ds-blog-row:hover { transform: translateX(12px); } .ds-blog-row:hover .ds-title { color: var(--accent); } .ds-arw { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s, transform 0.4s; } .ds-blog-row:hover .ds-arw { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(4px); }

components.name: Contact Mail
components.description: The human voice — serif mailto, accent underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-mail { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: clamp(48px, 8.5vw, 128px); line-height: 1.02; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; padding-bottom: 6px; } .ds-mail:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }

components.name: Mono Label
components.description: Section kicker / index — the prompt text.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); font-feature-settings: 'tnum'; }

components.name: Terminal Block
components.description: Bare console pane — real prompt (ilhaam@lab:~$), platform vocabulary, instant output.
components.html:
ilhaam@lab:~$ whoami
ilhaam — platform engineer
resume 2026 — interactive shell
components.css: .ds-term { background: var(--bg-soft); border: 1px solid rgba(238,236,228,0.12); padding: 20px 22px; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-term-line { line-height: 1.8; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-term-prompt { color: var(--accent); margin-right: 10px; } .ds-term-out { color: var(--muted); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio presents itself as a live terminal session with root access: a near-black shell, one phosphor-lime accent used like highlighted output, and a machine voice (JetBrains Mono) carrying everything except the moments that belong to a human — the name, rendered in a warm serif. The visitor is not reading a résumé page; they are dropped into an operator console for the person behind it. Density is editorial-meets-console: generous vertical rhythm, hairline separators instead of cards, sharp corners everywhere, a fine grain like phosphor on glass. Depth is tonal, never shadowed. Motion is deliberate and transform-based, and fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
keyCharacteristics: Two voices: machine (mono) for everything, human (serif) for the name and headline moments.
One accent color, spent like terminal highlight: rare, meaningful, never decorative at scale.
No cards, no rounded corners, no shadows, no gradients — separation by hairline rules and spacing.
Index-numbered sections and mono labels make the whole page read like shell output.
Motion exists to reveal structure (clip-path, translate), never to bounce or decorate.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Lime Volt appears on ≤5% of any given screen. If a design needs more of it, the design is wrong — not the accent.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: If a string is part of the machine's output, it is mono. The serif is reserved for the human's name and its echoes — nothing else gets it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface that needs a shadow is a surface that needs a rethink. Separate with tone and rules, not elevation.

dos: Do keep the accent rare — a pulse dot, a hover, a selection (The Rarity Rule).
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tonal steps, never shadows or cards.
Do write every label in the mono voice, uppercase, tracked 0.25em.
Do animate with transforms and clip-paths only; honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do let Instrument Serif appear only where the human speaks (name, headline moments).
donts: Don't introduce cards, rounded corners, gradients, glows, or box-shadows — they break the console illusion.
Don't put the accent on more than ~5% of a screen.
Don't switch body text off JetBrains Mono — the machine voice is the identity.
Don't add decorative hero imagery, stock gradients, or template phrases; the terminal IS the imagery.
